summary: Semilux International Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held on April 16, 2026. Shareholders approved a share consolidation of up to 20:1 (with exact ratio and effective date at the board's discretion) and a corresponding amendment to the company's articles of association. The voting showed 32,053,560 votes for each proposal with 3,909,101 abstentions. This is a routine corporate action, not a special situation. Watch for the board's determination of the consolidation ratio and effective date.
